LESSON: CREATING SHAPES AND FORMS USING ICT

Grade: PP1
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: CREATING
Topic 6.1: Creating SHAPES AND FORMS USING ICT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Creating SHAPES AND FORMS USING ICT. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Display the ability to operate the gadgets for creating shapes
2. Create shapes using electronic gadgets for creativity
3. Appreciate own created shapes for fun

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Display the ability to operate the gadgets for creating shapes
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to display the ability to operate the gadgets for creating shapes. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Create shapes using electronic gadgets for creativity
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to create shapes using electronic gadgets for creativity. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Appreciate own created shapes for fun
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate own created shapes for fun. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At the market in your county, count 10 mangoes. Put them in 2 groups of 5. That is sorting and grouping.

Example 2: In class, count the desks in your row. Write the number in figures and in words.

Example 3: If you have 7 shillings and your parent gives you 5 more, you have 12 shillings. That is addition.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Creating SHAPES AND FORMS USING ICT.
2. Explain Creating SHAPES AND FORMS USING ICT to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.

4. Show that you can: Display the ability to operate the gadgets for creating shapes

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Creating SHAPES AND FORMS USING ICT. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Creating SHAPES AND FORMS USING ICT important to you?
